usedFor: Airtable holds the records and Google Drive holds the files that belong to them. When a record changes, “Create Folder” can set up a home for it in Google Drive, or “Create a new sheet or doc or slide” can start its paperwork.

bestTemplate.name: “Record Created Or Updated” in Airtable, then “Create Folder” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A folder per record keeps each client or project's files in one place from day one, and you can nest it inside a parent folder.

watchOut: “Record Created Or Updated” fires on edits as well as new rows, and it polls. The same record can run twice and make a second folder, so build in a check for an existing one.
